trying-to-conceive-blueprint.h1: Your Blueprint, your community and your tools are all here.

community.eyebrow: Women at your stage are in the group
community.text: A private, protected group for women who are trying too, kept separate from bump-and-baby content. No judgement and no comparison, wherever you are in the world. The private assistant inside answers your cycle questions at any hour and sends you to a doctor for anything clinical. We’ve emailed your invite too.

trying-to-conceive-blueprint.help: You can book a 1:1 with a licensed practitioner. Your own doctor is always your first call for anything clinical.

safety.text: See a doctor after about a year of trying under 35, about six months at 35 or over, or sooner if your periods are irregular or you have a known condition. If the waiting is weighing heavily on your mind, you can call MANI in Nigeria on 0809 111 6264.

cross_sell.h2: Want pregnancy and the baby years ready before you need them?

first-pregnancy-plan.h1: Your Plan, your community and your tools are all here.

community.eyebrow: Women at your stage are in the group
community.text: A moderated group of mums at your stage, wherever you are in the world. Someone is usually awake when you need to talk at 3am. We’ve emailed your invite too, so you always have it.

first-pregnancy-plan.help: You can book a 1:1 with a licensed practitioner. Your own doctor is always your first call for anything urgent.

safety.text: Any bleeding, or a reduction or change in your baby's movements, means you contact your doctor or maternity unit straight away, every time. Also go in for severe pain, a high fever, a bad headache with blurred sight, or a fall or blow to your bump. If your mind feels heavy, you can call MANI in Nigeria on 0809 111 6264.
